items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: Buddy DeFranco would come in town and work with us because he knew Louie.

ctx.x: No, that’s why I’m here, to get your story.

Yeah. I’ve been really lucky to live, I’ll be 81 next November and I just, for the little music schooling that I had I ended up in some pretty high profile places. And I love the guys I’ve met and played with, gee whiz you know. Louie Bellson was from my hometown. I got to do some things with Louie, played with Louie, and Buddy DeFranco would come in town and work with us because he knew Louie. And it’s been a good ride.
All right. Thanks for your time today.
